attributes.title: 2027 AASCB Annual Conference: Doubling Down on a United Profession
attributes.series: AASCB Annual Conference (American Association of State Counseling Boards)
attributes.organizer: American Association of State Counseling Boards
attributes.summary:
The American Association of State Counseling Boards meets February 7 to 9, 2027, at The Palms in Las Vegas. The conference is the main yearly gathering for people who regulate professional counselors: state board members, executive directors and staff, along with educators and organizations that work with licensing boards.

The 2027 theme, "Doubling Down on a United Profession," focuses on the growing variation in licensure requirements, scope of practice and pathways to independent licensure across states, and on how those differences affect legal and legislative challenges to state licensing. Sessions combine expert presentations with structured discussion aimed at practical solutions between jurisdictions.

Registration runs through the AASCB event page, which showed limited spaces remaining when we checked; payment is required before attending. The Palms block rate is $129 per night plus tax and resort fee until January 14, 2027, with complimentary self and valet parking for attendees. The conference pages do not mention continuing education credit.
